question: A (gating the certification decision): is certify/16n (unchanged, FREEZE_050) at family_bound 16 sound, deterministic, wall-free and faithful on 12 fresh noisy 16-state worlds at eps 0.05 run twice and 6 fresh worlds at eps 0.10, with eps-0 compatibility to certify/16e at bound 16 on 6 controls, so that it can be certified for declared N <= 16 under iid flips with eps <= 0.10 at delta 0.001 per record? B (non-blocking): with a conflict-only stop on 1 dedicated worker, does certify/16e at 20 states give run-to-run identical records, and does it decide any fresh 20-state world?

hypotheses.H1: certify/16n at bound 16 issues no WRONG certificate on 12 fresh eps-0.05 worlds over two passes and 6 fresh eps-0.10 worlds (30 records; any-WRONG chance <= 30 x 0.001 = 0.03 under the model)
hypotheses.H2: two passes give byte-identical canon16n records on 12/12 noise16 cases with 0 wall guard firings
hypotheses.H3: every part A record is reproduced exactly by api_checks driving certify/16n observation by observation (run once)
hypotheses.H4: at eps 0 certify/16n at bound 16 equals certify/16e at bound 16 on 6/6 controls under the 052 IDF-equivalence rule
hypotheses.H5: noise16 eps-0.05 ID+IDF is at least 4/12; the eps-0.10 count is reported, not predicted
hypotheses.H6: B: with a conflict-only stop (wall guards record walls but never change a result) certify/16e records on 6 fresh 20-state worlds run twice are byte-identical on 6/6; the ID+IDF count is reported, not predicted

design.api: no new API and no change to certify/16n (FREEZE_050), certify/16e (FREEZE_049) or certify/16s (FREEZE_051). Study code only: new runner, recount, reference, api_checks and gates files for 053. The conflict-only stop is a runner-level setting (no wall-based stop passed to the API; the runner's hard job kill stays as a safety net and any kill is a gated failure). Host-agnostic core unchanged

parts.noise16: A. 12 fresh clean 16-state worlds (generator as 049 scale16), iid flips eps 0.05, eps_bar 0.10, delta 0.001, family_bound 16, arms API16N16 and API16N16_b
parts.noise16_bar: A. 6 fresh 16-state worlds, iid flips eps 0.10 (at eps_bar), arm API16N16 once
parts.compat16: A. 6 fresh clean 16-state controls: API16N16 at eps 0 vs API16E at bound 16, labels and canonical machines compared
parts.scale20c: B. 6 fresh clean 20-state worlds (generator as 050/051 scale20), certify/16e at bound 20, C20 50000, B20 2000000, run twice, conflict-only stop, all 12 jobs serial on 1 dedicated worker

design.workers: 8: 1 dedicated to part B (serial), 7 for part A, run concurrently in one phase
design.labels: ID, IDF (identified from the current state, not the start), AMB, IDU, WRONG; scored against the clean truth

cases.jobs: noise16 12 x 2 = 24; noise16_bar 6; compat16 6 x 2 = 12; scale20c 6 x 2 = 12; total 54

certification_rule: certify/16n becomes certified for declared N <= 16 (eps <= 0.10, delta 0.001) iff every gate except GS20C_det53 and GS20C_sound53 passes. Part B gates are published as pass or fail and never change that decision; a part B WRONG would still be published as a certify/16e soundness failure at 20 states

secondary.GN16_rate53: ID+IDF of 12 (eps 0.05) and of 6 (eps 0.10) with Wilson CIs, reads per observation, k range
secondary.GS20C_rate53: scale20c conflicts/s per chunk and per case, max chunk wall, with walls not used for any decision

gate_dependency_rule: each gate is scored from its own counts; label gates use recounted labels if G_recount passes, else the study labels with the failure stated; an unfinished reference is a GS_ref failure, published as-is
what_counts_as_failure: any gated criterion false; any part A wall guard firing fails GDET53 and GQB27; any part B hard kill fails GS20C_det53; AMB and IDU are not soundness failures
freeze_rule: no file named in the source freeze is edited after the freeze; new behaviour in new files or a deviation addendum. Caps, guards, eps, eps_bar, delta, the k rule, the stop rule, workers and case lists are part of the freeze
runtime_estimate: worst case at 050's slowest observed rate 4503 conflicts/s: part B serial 12 x (2000000/4503 + 10) = 12 x 454 = 5448 s, above 3600 s, so part B is planned at the cut size; part A 24 x (1500000/4503 + 10) + 6 x 343 + 12 x (3000000/4503 + 10) = 8232 + 2058 + 8114 = 18404 job-seconds on 7 workers, about 2630 s. Cut rule (applied at the pre-freeze projection, never after the freeze): if projected part B exceeds 3300 s, scale20c drops to 3 cases run twice (6 jobs); if projected part A exceeds 3300 s, noise16_bar drops to 3 cases, never noise16 or compat16. The cut is declared in the pre-run deviation
process: LEAN, under a standing go only if one is in force and cited; a ledgered build_authorization_053 before any code and before seedcheck_053. Plan locked before data; seedcheck before seeds; no cap calibration; independent recount; CNF reference audit; api_checks once after the run; pre-freeze smoke on 12130001-12130006 with the real release verifier chain; one main run, no tuning, no reruns, no relaunch (resume clause not approved); failures published; one fresh-clone verify plus tests
next_if_pass: all part A gates pass: certify/16n becomes certified for declared N <= 16 under iid flips with eps <= 0.10 at per-record failure probability <= 0.001 (Exact conditional on the model and declared N). Part B: if GS20C_det53 passes, the conflict-only stop is the fix for run-to-run variance at 20 states and the next scale20 version raises decisions (a different encoding or search, not more budget); if it fails, the variance is not wall-driven; find its source
next_if_fail: GN16_sound53 fails on WRONG: certify/16n is unsound at 16 states under its own model; withdraw the N <= 12 claim pending cause. Non-vacuity only: report; the budget at 16 states gets its own version. GDET53 or GQB27 fails on guard firings: carry the conflict-only stop to part A in the next version. GDET53 fails with 0 firings or GFID53 fails: find the source, ship nothing new. GCOMPAT16N53 fails: the eps-0 path at bound 16 differs from certify/16e; fix it. GS_ref fails on time only: the reference gets its own version. G_RT fails: publish it. certify/16n stays certified for N <= 12 unless a soundness failure is found
limitations: still needs a declared size N
iid flips with a known bound only; correlated or adversarial noise not covered
delta is per record; the model bound over 30 records is 0.03
walls depend on the host; only guard firings are gated in part A
part B is small (6 worlds) and non-blocking; decisions at 20 states are not predicted
open_items: a different 20-state encoding or search: Open
claim_scope: conditional on the declared N: an ID or IDF means unique among machines with at most N states consistent with the majority-corrected trace; IDF identifies the machine from the current state, not the start. Inferred reason: a larger machine can copy the true machine on every visited state and differ only where the trace never reaches, so a size bound is inherent. Further conditional on iid flips with eps <= eps_bar; holds with probability >= 1 - delta per record
